title: Evaluation artefact
description: One capability's result, written by its gate to eval/<capability>/gate.json (ADR-0011). The evaluation table is assembled from these files and from conf/lineage_chain.toml, never by hand.

protocol_hash.description: Identity of the frozen protocol this result was produced under: the config hash, spec hash or rule hash the gate re-derives from.

model.description: Model identity, or null for a capability that runs no model.

prompt.description: Prompt version, or null for a capability that runs no prompt.

population.description: What was measured over: a named set and its size, plus whatever pins it (snapshot id, index generation, frame name).

pipeline_run_id.description: The pipeline_runs row that produced the measured outputs, or null only when the capability did not run.

metric.description: The number this gate prints, with its threshold beside it. A reproducibility gate's number is its constituent count.

constituents.description: The gate's named constituent lines, verbatim, so the table can be traced back to printed output.

cut_reason.description: Mandatory when status is NOT_RUN. 'not reached by submission date' is a legitimate reason and is written as such.

allOf.description: A capability that did not run carries a written reason and no metric.
REPORTED is a quality vocabulary: a reproducibility claim either holds or does not.
